status_effects.explanation: Overwhelmed by resurfacing grief during the performance, Swann loses emotional composure and must conceal his tears from the room.

appraisal_events.evidence: "Swann aperçut, immobile en face de ce bonheur revécu, un malheureux qui lui fit pitié... C'était lui-même"; "il dut baisser les yeux pour qu'on ne vît pas qu'ils étaient pleins de larmes"
appraisal_events.explanation: Swann pictures his suffering former self as a pitiable, weeping stranger and must hide his tears from those around him, a moment of exposed vulnerability and lost composure in company.
